description: Create an article (Artikel) or replace its members: name and frame_ids in reading order (a new article needs them; for an existing one they replace all members). One text frame brings its whole story. Anchored objects are rejected (invalid_argument, details.code anchored_object – they follow their text anyway), an id named twice too (details.code duplicate_frame_id); objects on parent pages, objects already in another article and frames of a story listed twice give a warning. position start | end | before | after (with relative_to, another article) orders the articles; export (default true for a new article) includes it in the export. use_for_tagged_pdf (default true) switches the document setting „Für Lesereihenfolge im getaggten PDF verwenden“ on – without it articles do not change the PDF; false switches it off for the whole document. Returns article {name, index, export, members[]}, created, use_for_tagged_pdf, use_for_tagged_pdf_changed and article_names[].

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

export.description: Include the article in the export. Default true for a new article, otherwise unchanged.

frame_ids.description: Object ids in reading order (text frames, image frames, groups). Required for a new article.

name.description: Article name; an existing article of this name is changed.

position.description: Where the article goes among the articles. Default: new ones at the end, existing ones stay.

relative_to.description: The other article for position before or after.

use_for_tagged_pdf.description: Use the articles for the reading order of a tagged PDF (document setting). Default true.

name: define_article
title: Define an article (reading order)
